clean_body: LA Times: California election experts sound alarm as rate of rejected ballots quadruples| | | Stats like this from California are the canary in the coal mine, Team. Kern County went from 332 uncounted, late ballots in 2024 to 3,303 in 2025. In Riverside County it was almost 6,000 uncounted, late ballots, more than double 2024's total.Remember: These are from eligible voters, postmarked on time, sent ahead of or on Election Day. They should have counted -- except Trump's changes to the USPS made them arrive too late. = | | | | = Here's the deal, Team: Due to USPS changes, a huge number of mail-in ballots arrived too late to be counted in last year's special election in California. A review by the Los Angeles Times showed that "ballots came in late at an average rate four times higher than that of the 2024 election." By California law, vote-by-mail ballots are considered late if they do not arrive within seven days of election day, even if they are postmarked on or ahead of election day. What does this mean? There is now concrete proof that Trump's changes to the U.S. Postal Service are aiding his attacks on mail-in voting. California voters did their job and mailed their ballot in accordance with their laws. Trump's attacks on the Postal Service aren't letting them deliver those ballots on time. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | = | | = | | = | | | = | | = | | = | | | Election officials warned before that 2025 special election that the Postal Service changes could delay the postmarking of ballots and lead to votes not being counted. Trump's USPS leadership shrugged after reducing the number of post office pickups in a quest for "efficiency". “ Something changed ,” said Melvin E. Levey, who heads the Merced County Registrar of Voters. “ We don’t like seeing late ballots and if someone has made the effort to vote, we want to count it.” Semi-rural Merced County saw almost a sevenfold increase in late-arriving mail ballots in the November election compared with the year before. We have to make sure every voter understands this change and how it can impact them \-- from vote-by-mail, to bills, taxes, legal replies to companies, so much more. name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Trump is refusing to sign our housing bill that passed. I’m fighting back.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
Congress actually passed something good.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2940%2E4032634%2EPOQFwB)
---
I don’t say this often these days, but Congress actually passed something good. We just overwhelmingly passed the most substantial housing bill in more than 30 years. My 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act would lower housing costs, build more homes, help working families afford rent and homeownership, and prevent private equity firms from scooping up homes that families could own. Republicans were even boasting about it this morning — saying what a great bill it was. It was ready to become law this morning. And then, suddenly, Donald Trump threw a tantrum and refused to sign it. Why? Because he's demanding Congress pass the SAVE Act first — the restrictive voter ID law that would make it harder for millions of citizens to vote. Or as Donald Trump said, "guarantee the midterms" for the Republicans. | [](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3683?t=8&akid=2940%2E4032634%2EPOQFwB)
---
[**Trump is blocking relief for millions of families struggling to afford rent and buy a first home because he wants leverage to force through his extremist voter suppression bill. But make no mistake: I will not stop fighting to get this signed. Will you chip in $28 right now to fuel our fight?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3683?amount=28&t=9&akid=2940%2E4032634%2EPOQFwB)

I need to make this abundantly clear: We are in a housing emergency. People across this country are saying that housing is at the top of their list of costs that they are struggling with. Passing this bipartisan bill showed that even when Democrats are in the minority, we can get stuff done and deliver lower costs for American families. We got everyone on board to bring down costs, crack down on corporate landlords and private equity firms buying up neighborhoods, and put homeownership back within reach for working families. Even Donald Trump said himself that he supported this housing bill. The White House even called it "one of the most significant pieces of housing affordability legislation in American history." Then the President just turned around and acted like a petulant child the minute it’s time to sign the bill. We can laugh and joke about his dramatics, but this is serious. This is really serious for the young family that can't buy a home. This is really serious for the renter who sees his rent going up again and just doesn't know how he's going to cover both health insurance and rent. This was a serious effort to lower costs, and Donald Trump won’t sign it for political games. [**No games. No theater. No tantrums. I’m calling on Trump to sign this bill immediately — and I won’t let up in this fight. If you're able, will you pitch in $28 or any amount to power our campaign?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3683?amount=28&t=15&akid=2940%2E4032634%2EPOQFwB) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

July 21 starts the clock on the most important governor's race in the country. |
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133957146/629639358/-1397648958?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260624_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZjc3NGZjMzQtMmE3MC1mMTExLWFjOWMtMDAwZDNhNTRiZWQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=56482wQM2ZQBe-1IJzfl1cZgu8mUVZLRjuoTTO9MfyE=)

Team, Our end of quarter deadline is right around the corner. Here’s what we’re working towards:
* **Protect our Democratic trifecta** — defending our Governor, Secretary of State, and Attorney General.
* **Expand our state legislative map** to ensure fair representation in every corner of the state.

Friend, Deb Haaland here. We are living through a defining moment. This November, across the country — right here in New Mexico and our neighboring state Texas — elections will determine whether we fight for our values or allow extremism and chaos to take hold.
**We are facing real issues that demand real leadership, and that's why I'm reaching out today._[Will you split a contribution of $5 between Gina Hinojosa's campaign for Governor of Texas and my campaign for Governor of New Mexico?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5897?refcode=jtk950-bu-nd&amount=5&t=2&akid=10542%2E400544%2E6PD7NH)_**
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Gina Hinojosa and Deb Haaland will go through immediately:_ | | | [Donate $10 >>](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/8813?refcode=jtk950-bu-nd&t=3&akid=10542%2E400544%2E6PD7NH)

Across the country, Democratic governors are leading the fight to lower costs, expand opportunity, protect healthcare, strengthen public schools, and stand up for working families. Together, we have the opportunity to elect two more Democratic governors who are ready to deliver this November.

I'm running for Governor because New Mexico deserves leadership that will tackle the challenges families face every day and build a future where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.
And in neighboring Texas, my friend Gina Hinojosa is running to fight for strong public schools, affordable healthcare, lower costs, and a state government that works for working people.

Sound familiar?
Friend, the truth is that what happens in Texas affects New Mexico, and vice versa. Our states share a border, but we also share families, workers, businesses, and communities. The decisions made by Texas leaders can have consequences that ripple across our entire region.
For years, Texans have lived under Republican leadership that has put politics ahead of solving problems. Texans deserve better. And New Mexicans deserve a partner next door who is focused on expanding opportunity, protecting freedoms, and delivering real results.
Gina and I believe in the same future for our states: One where working families can get ahead, where every child has access to a great education, where healthcare is within reach, and where the government works for people. **_I know Gina and I will be strong partners in that work._**
**But this partnership won’t be possible without you, friend.[If you're ready to help elect governors who will fight for working families across the Southwest, please split a contribution of $5 — or whatever makes sense for you — between our campaigns today. Every donation helps us reach more voters, build stronger campaigns, and compete against well-funded Republican opponents.](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5897?refcode=jtk950-bu-nd&t=7&akid=10542%2E400544%2E6PD7NH)**

---
Thank you.

Be Fierce,
Deb

| | Today marks 4 years since the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_. Four years since reproductive health care and bodily autonomy were ripped away from millions of Americans. This was the biggest strike in a generation against the constitutional right to privacy in our country. And the Trump administration has been eager to build on this crusade against reproductive freedom wherever possible. Trump has rescinded guidance that protects emergency reproductive care in hospitals. He pardoned anti-choice protestors who'd been found guilty of harassment and violence outside of health clinics. He revoked Defense Department funding for service members who need to travel to receive reproductive health care. Meanwhile, his enablers in Congress continue to legislatively chip away at reproductive rights. **Republicans' "One Big Beautiful Bill" included – among its many horrible features – a complete defunding of Planned Parenthood for the year. Since then, clinics have shut down, and women have been left without the health care they need.** But there's one fundamental truth that anti-choice Republicans forget:**the American people don't sit quietly when their rights are taken away.** Time and time again over the last four years, we've seen record turnout in down-ballot races against anti-choice extremists. Voters in "red" states such as Montana, Ohio, Kentucky, and Kansas have defeated abortion bans or passed abortion protections. Last year in Wisconsin, with abortion rights potentially on the line, the GOP's effort to retake the State Supreme Court failed spectacularly (with their candidate losing by _ten points_). There is a path to restoring reproductive freedom _everywhere_ in America – and it starts with flipping the Senate in November. If we do that, we can stop any piece of anti-choice legislation in its tracks and block Trump from appointing more anti-choice judges. **And when a Democratic administration (hopefully) takes office in 2029, our congressional majorities will be ready to immediately codify the rights that**** _Roe_****granted.** Our fight ahead won't be easy, but it can be won. Freedom is a powerful thing – and voters in red, blue, and purple states alike want it. So let's get to work. [**Will you join me? **Peter, Donald Trump is leaving people behind.**
The President is _refusing_ to sign landmark affordable housing legislation with wide bipartisan support unless he gets his extreme voter suppression bill.
[](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260624-2.CVeDXA&refcode=em-20260624-2&t=2&akid=1541%2E1086043%2EjCdkxU)

We need to know one thing...
Peter,November is closer than you think, and 2026 is shaping up to be the most important election of our lifetime.Here's the deal: **House Republicans have been getting it DONE.** We **codified** President Trump's Executive Orders into law. They want to undo every single win we've fought for -- your tax cuts, your border security, your energy independence._**If we lose this majority, it all gets erased. We have to keep building on this momentum, every single day, all the way to November.[**Click HERE to take our Official 2026 Turnout Tracker and tell us what's got you fired up this election season.**](https://timmoore.cmail20.com/t/y-l-foohl-hkhielhuy-i/) [CHIME IN HERE](https://timmoore.cmail20.com/t/y-l-foohl-hkhielhuy-d/) We will win -- because we MUST win -- to save America.Thank you, Congressman Tim Moore

| Dear Friends,

Every year families work harder, yet take home less.
Every year government grows larger and more expensive.
And every year the same politicians promise solutions while the problems only get worse.

**Enough is enough.**
In the video above, Jerrod Sessler delivers a direct message: Washington, D.C. created this mess, and it's time for real leadership that will cut the waste, stop the reckless spending, and put America first again.

That's exactly why Jerrod is running for Congress.

He's bringing the **[Rescue Washington](https://sendmanage.jerrodforcongress.com/send1/l/cRwY2WMZosKKG664LUBf1w/JyEIyHxr4WsVEdTiOGwF2w/nv1d3cD9t4hxoO3vSvHMJA)** plan to the table -- a practical strategy focused on protecting working families, restoring fiscal sanity, and delivering the common-sense representation our district deserves.

With ballots arriving in **just three weeks** , we're entering the most critical phase of this campaign. The final push to reach voters and secure victory in the August primary will take every resource we can muster right now.

## UN to Resume Nuclear Inspections in Iran
The U.N. nuclear watchdog said [inspections of Iran's nuclear sites](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL1urDAQRp8GOpAZ8-NbuLgN3aZNiQZ7vExkbGR7F_H2EVHeIN2RRhqd830-lgey5_D8wJ10cXEJdGZPpVBawst4wsQhH2QKx5Bxp8QGFxAwNmJsYFgssr-WvrbaEQHJmnQ3KZAKum6oNz26blKyt6aXa6-kMmIS5p9TK7h1oEnWrO9vYoShE0LJoXW2H9fV0SDQoVJT1QuyXGJqvyKHspHzV3xTak3ca6-3Uo5cyf8VzBXM53m2F24x3tcK5jungvmIngubGzEVNp5u3Aht8wrNb2iDTwrmajJeuelEB1INqm-3svs6aXuc7D3n8RZ67sj-R6D8abW3hu8AAAD__0kLgZk) will happen under the new U.S.-Iran deal, though it gave no timeline as leaders in both countries sent mixed signals. President Trump said the war is going "very well," with Iran making major concessions during the 60-day negotiating window opened by a memorandum the two presidents signed last week. Meanwhile, Trump labeled as "meaningless" a Senate vote on Tuesday directing the president to [remove the U.S. military](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOnTAQRb8GOiMzxkDjIg3dpk2JBjzeN5vBRrbfI-_vI6L8wZZXV7o65_76WD-QhePnTzzI1ZDWSFcRqpXyGp-7EGaO5aS9cooFD8q84woaRqVHBXb1yPJeh9a7QARkWnL9NIOZoe9t-3DDNk-T8ZsepwlCoN72s4FpsF4Hq41p2d1regTbaz0b2wU_jNsWyGoMOM9TM2jyXFPuvhLH-qAg7_Si3O3paMU9aj1LY340sDSwXNfVhfTntrj7BhbhF6k7N7A8i-KMUZ2EOylPKOq_pKoov4vikpFECW0YU1R7ikF4r-rrGUnBoG7UNjt_XizCZbzhPg9k-QdTv_Xgy8HfAAAA__9zVYZW) from fighting against Iran.
## Trump Halts Housing Bill over Voting Law
President Trump abruptly [canceled the signing](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDFuxCAQRU9jd1h4DCxbUKRxt2lTWhgP9kQYLGDX2ttHjnKDNCONvvT0_v96TA9LgeL6aXc01acp4lkC1op5ik8X0GaK5UBXKcVid8zk7AQcFOOKgZwWS-E9iXYxHhFwaNH0Nw2Dhr6X7Wb4Xd-dR3lX2ruZoxOWo3ReKNHPvO9bMheNK5A953qQnV-EmmePkltvtb41guNCNeXuO1GsG_rwTi_MnUt7G8xW61Ga4aOBsYHxPM_OxdldYQPjhW5g5NcB0cBY83M_mLPRYShsS89CcWUzhcAKrfF6in0h-2vKrKvdVvfQZrMcJ4VARV1G624p_BrUf832MvATAAD__3Qlgcs) of a bipartisan housing bill Wednesday, refusing to sign until the Senate passes his signature elections bill, the SAVE America Act. The housing bill [cleared both chambers](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLuO5CAURL8GZ7R4-BkQrLRy1qvNNrQu-GLfFQYL6G713488M38waZVUOqf-3Zc7UKC4_YEDTfVpifgqAWvFvMSHCwiZYjnRVUqxwIGZHCxKqJ6LnqtuWYHCe2mb1XhEhbpBI4dR6VFJ2TW7QQAHfpjcqry1buiUHwV4C15PdpK-IXOtiV51UohRdze_tr21HjsBHsZxYK3AlWrKt_-JYt3Rh3d6Yr65dDTB7LWehelfTM1MzWDdZXB1TM1_U6BKrjA11_w4Tu4gOgyFF9oixY1bOiFXKhD5nh7lKwqBF3gi_7Zlai415TfTM61M_5a6lf3USdlks54vCoFKf1FuB1D4pKo_uvJp1EcAAAD__564ixE) with overwhelming bipartisan support, limiting big investors from buying single-family homes and easing building rules to boost supply. The SAVE America Act would add proof-of-citizenship and [voter ID rules](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGupSAURb9GOwweBZmCYhq7N-2U5ghHPS8IBrjP3L-feH9hql3sZGft9fdr-UIOHPc_eJKtW1oi3SVQrZSX-HKBMHMsF7nKKRY8KbPDBSRoIbUAtXjk8F7G1tuNCGhoyfaTgcFA36v2sODHXwCoFeCEZAyu6PW6SqXNBHLqW7bPmtSgeinNoLrNj3pdN1ISNzRmakZJnmvK3XfiWA_awjv9UO5cOttgj1qv0gy_G5gbmO_77uLqnhdP38B8pcCVXWlg9ili8KLm13k1MH9SOIyOQhFXwCgK71Gc-J2yONKrcNzFyiGIjfejFuFS3DOVItBVkV3EQfVKmTZbf90cAhf94O4ncvjg1f9y-mPhXwAAAP__P3OOOA). It has stalled in the Senate, where Republicans lack the votes to break a filibuster. Speaker Mike Johnson said Trump still plans to sign the bill within his 10-day window while the House considers [pursuing reconciliation](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDHO4yAUhE9jd0T4YTApKLZxl223tAg8woswREAS5fYrR_8N_m6kkWbmm3-X7WIpUb79tTuaHsqW8d0S9o51y0-X0FbK7YGuU8nN7ljJ2Q04KMYVA7l5S-mzzaM3ARFQjGimRYPQME1yjEYJnLX03in0gkt79nKB6cqD1iKEBUcyRxpXICfOtZCn4Gd1vQaU3Aar9TLMHD31Uk_3QrlHDOlTXlhPruxjMrH3RxvEnwHWAdYeMVJKhzfAGsuOB9BXPhsOsMqz0ELPrNkXsh8eZl1nFV3JjhLZA5XdS8yt5AHWsRr_eFNK1NQx5rZb-haM_VePvQz8DwAA__-uUID8) for the elections measure, a path the Senate parliamentarian has said shouldn't be allowed.
## Slate Unveils America's Cheapest Truck
Slate Auto, the EV startup backed by Jeff Bezos, revealed a $24,950 starting price for its electric pickup, the cheapest truck in America. [See the truck here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL-OnDAQh58GukFmwJwpKNLQXdqUaDDjxYexkT27p83TR0R5g9S_P9L3_fpcPskHHx8_6eRJXFoif5fAIpyX-LSBKftYLrbiUyx0cvaWFlQ4gBoA9bKRD--lr7fJMSN3NU_th8HOYNvqep-6DrdxRWxH04_K4ag7Y7BvdcvbyqRrP91vakDdKmU63bitH9bVsVbkyJiPqle8eUm5-Uo-ys4uvNOLc2PTWYdpF7lK1f2ocK5wdj5StNy8aU_pblQ4n5QPllLhTFm8DVzh_MXOwcq_U4GV7MEblEDCkPnFFApgP2oFRe5FfMCVvWVwKQO_4PL2eF5w0nFHXkB2BrszXVwEJD_tAT7CP1nQomp7o3vd7HKGOk_b9e1D8GW40R4n-fAXRf7L_2vCPwEAAP__XD2b7A). The no-frills two-seater skips paint, touchscreens, and power windows, [holding costs down](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL-OtCAUxZ8GOwxeBfkKiq-xm223NAiX8c6iGGDGzD79xn2F7U5ykvPn93mbb5Yi7fcPu6GpIc07niVirZjn_eki2kx7OdBVSnuxG2ZydgYBigvFQc7eUnzPQ-NNQATsGzTdqKHX0HWyWY2UAhE8Kq87oUYRhkX1XnSjc1YJDQ2ZK00okJ0Qupdt8INaloBS2GC1Htkg0FNNuX0k2uuKIb7TC3Pr0tZEs9Z6FNb_ZzAxmM7zbN1SrheXz2C6JIOpRFuR1_x0XxwjuprJ8Reu5CLyB4bAF_xOhcPwTwp-ZHLIYGqy8cdJMVJR15D7Zin-Ftc_0XoZ-AkAAP__hbF_Tw) with a bare body and hand-cranked windows. More than 180,000 people have already made a small deposit to reserve a vehicle, and the company [aims to profit](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL3OnDAURJ8GOiNzwV4oXKSh27QpkX-ul5s1NrLNon37iLzC10wz0pnR-fNcn5oCxddvvaOqPq0RrxKwVsxrPG1AnSmWA22lFIveMZPVK3CQjEsGYnWawncdW6c8IuDQouofEwwT9L1oNyWtmbmYjRy4E1Y8RivG0YCfneazsKIlddO4BNFzPg2i826UxngUXHs9TY9m5Oioptz9TRTrhj580wdzZ9PeBrXVepRm-NXA0sByXVdno7F32cByoxtY-B0wNrCUoCsy_LCD7Ps8WM2nfTOLiZmzUMRS2CvpULqt7qHNyh0XhUBF3jdeu6bwf7b-yNVHwb8AAAD__3nmfUw) on every truck from day one, with deliveries due late this year. The launch arrives as EV demand sags after the federal tax credit expired. Slate is betting a sub-$25,000 base-price sticker still wins over budget-minded buyers.
